summary: Sprott Physical Copper Trust (COP) filed a Form 6-K with a Material Change Report reporting unitholder approval to restructure from a non-redeemable investment fund to a mutual fund, effective May 1, 2026. The amendments replace a semi-annual redemption feature with monthly redemptions, removing the previous 1.5% cap on units redeemed per period. Consequential changes were made for a NYSE Arca listing. No financial terms, advisor, or premium are mentioned. The restructuring enhances liquidity, potentially attracting broader investment. Monitor trading volumes and actual monthly redemption activity for investor behavior post-change.
